Good morning. **Andrew** here, having watched another interminable **Donald
Trump** rally, because you, dear reader, absolutely shouldn't have to. The
good news is I can safely tell you why**Abdul El-Sayed** is begging Trump to
come to Michigan, to campaign for **Mike Rogers**.

In today's **' First Draft,'** the president bear-hugs the candidates he's
dragging down, **Susan Collins** has always loved donations from federal
contractors, and Trump's illegal war with Iran drags on. Let's read in.

Contrary to what Republicans and pro-Israel Democrats would have you think,
[leftist streamer Hasan Piker](https://zeteo.com/p/top-republicans-privately-
admit-their) isn't the 2026 cycle's most toxic campaign surrogate - not even
close.

Nor is Bernie Sanders, despite Elon Musk and his super PAC's [endless
fearmongering](https://zeteo.com/p/elon-musk-endorsed-socialist-healthcare)
about the Vermont socialist. Senate candidate Troy Jackson, locked in a tight
race against incumbent GOP Senator Susan Collins, will happily campaign with
Sanders all over Maine this weekend. (A [new Marist
poll](https://x.com/PollTracker2024/status/2107321069434478881) has Jackson
four points up on the Republican incumbent.)

The most toxic campaign surrogate in America this year, without question, is
Donald J. Trump. The historically unpopular president is expected to cost his
party control of the House and potentially the Senate in November - and he
insists on bear-hugging and publicly campaigning with the GOP's most
vulnerable candidates regardless.

After Trump [told](https://rollcall.com/factbase/trump/transcript/donald-
trump-press-gaggle-before-marine-one-departure-october-5-2026/) reporters on
Monday he'll be heading to Michigan, Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-
Sayed publicly pleaded for him to visit the state and campaign for his
Republican opponent, Mike Rogers.

**" Donald, please, I'm asking you, come to Michigan,"** El-Sayed said,
[speaking](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2107273677557702883) on MS NOW. **" I
dare you to come."**
